name: claude-mod-ity
description: Claude Code mods. They are commodities.

plugins.name: mod-divider
plugins.description: Draws a divider line, in a character you choose, between the bands other mods show above the prompt.

plugins.name: github-panel
plugins.description: GitHub issues assigned to you, in a pane inside Claude Code and Claude Desktop. A button above the prompt toggles it.

plugins.name: compact-courier
plugins.description: A Compact button in the prompt footer: Haiku summarizes the session in detail and that summary becomes the compaction.

plugins.name: next-action-hero
plugins.description: Buttons above the prompt for the choices Claude's last reply offered: yes/no, A/B/C, list items, Next: lines. A click sends that choice as your prompt.

plugins.name: fraktur-footer
plugins.description: Draws the prompt footer's mode labels (focus, memory paused) in the Fraktur letters of the GH and Compact buttons.

plugins.name: y2chaos
plugins.description: A loud Y2K-era Claude Desktop theme: a purple night with scanlines and a cream day, with an X-Files, Lone Star, Doug, Modern Life and file-sharing header.

plugins.name: erowid
plugins.description: A Claude Desktop theme drawn after erowid.org: black and periwinkle by night, gray-green and navy by day, with the maroon site header as a vector backdrop.
